what: Default appear for sites built with the site builder — an element appears once when its top edge crosses the line 10% from the bottom of the screen. The default (fade) is opacity 0→1 over 1.2s on a curve that brightens quickly at first and settles slowly. pop is scale 0→1 over .45s, popping out .1s late and settling after a slight overshoot (illustrations, speech bubbles). grow is vertical scale 0→1 and opacity 0→1 around a bottom-center axis over .3s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) (a new site builder version — a character peeking up over the footer). left slides in from 50px to the left over .6s ease-in-out while brightening (big hero text), and right comes in from 40px to the right over .8s with a .4s delay (side-by-side videos and cards). up floats up from 20px below over .8s with the default CSS ease while brightening (the site builder’s common fade up — the delay is often .3s and headline lines use 1.3s). settle lands a panel from 1.05× scale and angular corners to its own size and corners over .8s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1), and zoom resolves from 1.05× scale and transparent over the same length (hero panel and the photo inside it). blur resolves a panel from 50px blur over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) (opacity unchanged — a frosted glass panel). haze resolves from 10px blur and transparent (with a --fx-y shift) over 2s ease-out (the site builder’s &appear{filter: blur(10px); opacity: 0} — text and vertical titles rising out of mist) tilt starts transparent, offset (-25px, 24px) and rotated -15°, and drops into place over .6s (wall-hung tool and prop pictures — direction changed with --fx-x·--fx-y·--fx-rotate). gray returns its color from 68% grayscale over 1.4s (photos — setting --fx-o to 0 brightens them together from transparent). skew settles at a slant over 1s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) from a spot that is transparent, blurred 4px, skew(-2°,-2°), offset (-20,-20)px (STUDIO .appear{filter: blur(4px); transform: skew(-2deg,-2deg); translate: -20px -20px} — like text seen through fogged glass). xform takes STUDIO .appear’s free transform (a transform mixing rotation, skew, scale and offset) as --fx-transform and, together with opacity (--fx-o), returns to the element’s own shape — like the STUDIO version with no duration given, default duration 0s (right after the delay) and CSS default ease. xform-ls tightens together from .2em letter-spacing (vertical-writing text).

options.--fx-lead: /  Lead delay of pop type (css variable), default .1s — added before --fx-delay. Depends on the original STUDIO version, 0s if none (brand)
options.--fx-x: Initial horizontal offset of shift·drift (css variable), default 0px — together with --fx-y (the default --fx-y for these two types is 0px) · skew defaults to -20px for both
options.--fx-scale: Start scale of drift · start scale of zoom · start scale of haze (CSS variable), default 1 · zoom 1.05 — giving haze .5 makes it come into focus blurred and at half size, growing (person photo)
options.at: Appears once it crosses what % line from the top of the screen, default 90
options.--fx-dur: Durations — default fade 1.2s · pop .45s · grow .3s · settle·zoom .8s · haze 2s
options.--fx-origin: Grow axis (css variable), default bottom center
options.--fx-ease: fade · right curves (css variable), default cubic-bezier(.13,.62,.37,.95) — the old STUDIO version (207) uses CSS default ease. pop is also accepted (default cubic-bezier(.12,1.12,.63,1.19) — a STUDIO version without a set curve uses cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) .3s, brand)
options.--fx-y: Push distance of up (CSS variable), default 20px
options.--fx-blur: Initial blur of the blur type (css variable), default 50px · haze default 10px · skew default 4px (0px for panels without blur)
options.--fx-rotate: Initial tilt angle of tilt (css variable), default -15deg — --fx-x·--fx-y defaults are -25px·24px
options.--fx-gray: Initial grayscale level of gray (css variable), default 68%
options.--fx-o: Initial opacity (css variable) of gray and xform — gray defaults to 1, xform to 0. At 1, opacity is left as is and only the shape changes (sticker 1.3x → 1)
options.--fx-skew-x: Initial horizontal tilt of the skew (css variable), default -2deg — feature row text uses 2deg
options.--fx-skew-y: Initial vertical tilt of skew (CSS variable), default -2deg
options.--fx-sx: skew’s initial horizontal scale (css variable), default 1 — at -1 it returns by flattening and unfolding from a left-right flipped position (steam line drawing)
options.--fx-transform: Initial transform of xform (CSS variable), default none — the original .appear value as is, like ‹translate(90px, 67px) scale(.8)›
options.--fx-ls: Initial letter spacing of xform-ls (css variable), default .2em
options.look: widen: The panel width grows from 0 to the consumer’s width (opacity unchanged). Default .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1). Write a width in % or px on the panel that will expand (auto cannot transition). Brand hero navy panel
